validated.explanation: The deterministic pipeline reports verdict uncertain with zero physical failure events for window 1518-1639 (50.6-54.6s) and does not establish a failure type or earliest failure. Joint data shows a measured gripper opening at 51.6s but holding is not detectable from this joint, so opening alone is not a verified drop. End-of-episode SAM at 68.6s finds green plates outside/unknown relative to the rack, but the pipeline notes not every expected object has an established final position inside and that end-state cannot be established from mid-window observations far from episode end.

factual_claims.text: Pipeline found no supported physical failure events in this window (n_physical_events=0, verdict uncertain).
Gripper reading cannot show whether an object is held; a thin plate does not change the closed reading (0.4-0.6 measured vs commanded ~-0.2), so holding is not detectable from this joint.
Not every expected object has an established final position: green plate 0/? established inside.

End-of-episode plate observations at frame 2058: green plate:0 region=outside conf 0.97, green plate:1 region=unknown conf 0.89, green plate:2 region=unknown conf 0.92; end-state assessed from keyframe SAM only and ids not matched to window tracks.
Measured gripper opening at frame 1548 (51.6s) measured=14.991; opening alone is not a drop and holding is not detectable.

hypotheses.text: The gripper opening at ~51.6s may correspond to a release attempt, but without detectable holding signal the pipeline cannot verify whether a plate was held or dropped.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis

hypotheses.text: Plates observed outside/unknown at end-of-episode may indicate incomplete placement in rack, but final outcome is not established due to missing interior calibration and gap between window end and episode end.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis

visual_interpretations.text: F0 (50.6s) appears to show the red arm holding two green plates over the table near the dish rack.
F1 (51.6s) appears to show one plate tilted/released while the gripper is open above another plate on the table.
F2 (54.6s) appears to show two green plates resting on the table surface outside the rack with the gripper empty and lowered.
F3 (68.6s) appears to show one green plate on the table and at least one plate in the rack at episode end.

limitations: Gripper joint cannot distinguish holding vs empty closure for thin plates (E0), so grasp/drop cannot be verified from proprioception alone.
No interior calibration for rack footprint; final inside/outside assessments are unreliable (E2).
End-state SAM ids are from separate request and not matched to window track ids; mid-window engine cannot establish final outcomes when last observations are far from episode end (E2).
Missing SAM detections are not proof of absence; pipeline reported zero physical events.
